name: Sculptural editorial
prompt:
Create a polished, memorable desktop website UI design composition for the personal portfolio of Mohanad Yehia, Software QA Engineer. This is a real website screen design, not a mood board, not a poster, not a photograph of a computer. Landscape 1536 by 1024 pixels. Show a complete first viewport plus a restrained beginning of the selected-work section. Treat it as a premium independent design studio's commissioned portfolio: precise optical spacing, extremely accomplished typography, bold visual hierarchy, realistic implementable controls, original editorial composition. One coherent dark cinematic quality-lab world: deep graphite matte ground, warm white text, restrained amber lighting, polished dark chrome and translucent amber glass. Large original inspection sculpture built from stacked rectangular slabs, thin metal frames and separated transparent layers, as if exposing the layers of a complex software system. The sculpture must have meaningful physical form and exceptional lighting, not a generic sphere, torus, mascot, bug, glowing blob or stock coding illustration. Typography is a strong narrow modern grotesque display with clean readable sans body, no serif and no decorative terminal text. The design feels physical and authored, not generic dark SaaS, not a grid of three cards, not a fake control dashboard. Flat website screenshot with no browser chrome, no perspective on the page itself, no watermark. Exact visible website content: identity "Mohanad Yehia"; role "Software QA Engineer"; navigation "Work", "Approach", "About", "Contact"; primary headline "Complex systems." and "Clear evidence."; short body "Production QA across web, mobile, API, and data."; action "Explore the work"; secondary action "Resume"; a visible beginning of the next section with "Selected work", "TestPulse", and "Test observability & flake detection". Use only that factual content, do not invent metrics, availability badges, testimonials, report results, logos, status chips, location clocks, version numbers, or extra ornamental labels. The main headline is fully legible, never hidden by the sculpture. Accent gradients appear in the physical sculpture's lighting and materials, not on all UI text. Buttons have highly readable contrast and their labels fit one line. The top navigation is quiet and single line; the overall page has generous negative space balanced with decisive large content.
COMPOSITION A, SCULPTURAL EDITORIAL: a broad exhibition-like composition rather than a standard two-column landing page. Place the role and identity in the top-left. The oversized two-line headline anchors the lower-left and spans approximately two thirds of the screen width, with extremely confident scale. A tall exploded inspection sculpture floats prominently in the upper-right and center, above a subtle low plinth or light plane. The sculpture, title and large quiet negative-space region form a diagonal composition, with no competing small cards. The body and two actions form a compact readable block aligned to the title. At the bottom edge, a full-width TestPulse project entry begins with an elegant oversize project title and a single abstract image crop. Show how this world continues past the hero, without squeezing an entire long page into the image.
